threshold_selection: separately per seed/model/landmark on disjoint validation OOF Youden scores
threshold_caveat: OOF single-model scores versus test fivefold ensemble scores; sensitivity, not independent ensemble calibration
aggregation: within each seed: five fold probabilities average per patient/landmark -> metric; equal mean of seed-specific metrics; Macro averages three landmark metrics
seed_sd: sample standard deviation over seed42/44/71/2026 metrics, ddof=1; descriptive variability from four selected trainings
bootstrap_scope: fixed selected seed set and fitted models; shared patient draws across all seeds/models/landmarks, metric per seed then average; excludes retraining and seed-selection uncertainty; no seeds are resampled
